about: Legal questions put to the Acts by operations/compare_retrieval.py (plan AN.45, D107). COMPOSED, NOT SAMPLED (docs/GOLDEN_SET.md section 7): written from the golden set's verified authority (its section 6) and its scenarios, once in plain words (no Act's name, no number) and once naming the Act, each with the provisions that answer it - any one of them counts. They are not a model's own search phrases. Extend or correct them; a question needs an id used once, a style (plain or named), its words, and expect: the Act's exact title as the store holds it and the section as the store keys it (a schedule article is Article_65; a Code of Civil Procedure rule Order_XXXIX_Rule_1).
